comment:
Four inputs — Send 1 L/R Chain In and Send 2 L/R Chain In — are configured and are summed into the send outputs (Chain.cpp:268-271), but the widget adds no jack for them (Chain.cpp:384-394), so they read 0V and cannot be patched. The manual lists 'send-chain inputs' among the module's inputs.

The return inputs are multiplied by the larger of the two channels' send knobs for that loop, muted channels counting as zero (Chain.cpp:254-262). That is not how a conventional send and return works and it is not in the manual: with both send knobs down, a return is silent no matter what is patched to it.

The sends are taken after the fader and before the pan (Chain.cpp:198-204), so a send is mono-summed in position but follows the channel level.

The panel names the two channel strips CH 1-2 and CH 3-4. Each is one stereo channel, not two.

The mute CV test is written out twice in each channel, at Chain.cpp:191-192 and 227-228; the repetition has no effect.
